newsitem.title: UK: UK minister - jobless drop can't continue same pace.
newsitem.headline: UK minister - jobless drop can't continue same pace.

text.p: British education and employment secretary Gillian Shephard said on Wednesday she welcomed the latest jobless data but warned such drops cannot be expected to continue.
"These figures have also been boosted by the introduction of the new jobseekers allowance and we cannot expect falls of this size every month," she said in a statement.

Figures out on Wednesday showed the number of British jobless fell a staggering 95,800 in November, the largest monthly drop on record. The total number of unemployed is now below two million for the first time since 1991.
But the Office for National Statistics said sweeping changes to the benefits system, including the new jobseekers allowance, may have accounted for 25,000 of that drop.

"I'm delighted that so many people have found work in the run-up to Christmas," Shephard said. "For those that are still looking, these figures provide clear evidence that the search for work is worthwhile and they can look forward to the new year with increasing confidence."
